t: The facility of the United States Postal Service located at 215 West Industrial Park Road in Harrison, Arkansas, shall be known and designated as the “John Paul Hammerschmidt Post Office Building”.

fable.w: This section only names a Postal Service facility; Congress makes the designation directly by statute. There is no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving anyone outside the federal government, so nothing here is even a tempting basis for participation.
